title: Cloudberries

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Cloudberries are berries found growing on the ground in Plains.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text: • Bushes in the Plains biome. Berries will respawn after 300 minutes, 5h. Cloudberry plants will remain intact if ground cover is cleared with the hoe, but they will not regrow if destroyed.
